In October 2025, AMD entered into a product purchase agreement with OpenAI OpCo, LLC (OpenAI) to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, with the deployment of the first gigawatt of capacity powered by its AMD Instinct MI450 series products [1]. Concurrently, AMD issued a warrant to OpenAI to purchase up to an aggregate of 160 million shares of AMD’s common stock at an exercise price of $0.01 per share [2]. This warrant was subject to vesting based on certain AMD Instinct GPU purchase milestones, stock price targets, and technical and commercial conditions, and was exercisable through October 5, 2030 [2]. However, none of the warrant shares met the vesting conditions, and thus the warrant did not vest [2]. 

Therefore, the agreement signed by AMD with OpenAI in 2025 was a product purchase agreement for the deployment of 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs, including the first gigawatt using the AMD Instinct MI450 series, along with a warrant for the purchase of AMD shares.
